title: Kangavar, Kermanshah Province - September 3, 2026
text:
Kangavar, Kermanshah Province - September 3, 2026"

"🔆🔅The funeral ceremony for Martyr Colonel Alireza Shakibafar, an IRGC Aerospace Force commander, was held in city of Kangavar, Kermanshah Province."

"Shakibafar was among four IRGC Aerospace Force members killed in a U.S. attack on Kermanshah on September 2. His body was first carried through the city on Wednesday night during the "We are avengers" gathering."

"The main funeral procession and burial took place on Thursday morning at 9:00 AM, starting from Imam Khomeini Square in Kangavar and ending at the city's martyrs' cemetery."

"According to reports, Shakibafar was a father of three—two daughters and a young son—who were awaiting his return. The other martyrs from the same attack were identified as Reza Mohammadi, Shahram Jafari, and Jafar Kahrizi.
